title: A Vow for the Orchard
author: August Coldharbour
blurb: Beatrix Vane, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
